recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The core FHIR source already implements the published FHIR-18186 decision; FHIR-48981 was reviewed only as later context and can be reconciled independently if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-18186 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request asking that PlanDefinition actions be able to reference a URI for a non-FHIR definition, not only a canonical reference to a FHIR definitional resource.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#03255f090f. Commit 03255f090f changed the then-authoritative PlanDefinition spreadsheet from PlanDefinition.action.definition to PlanDefinition.action.definition[x] and changed the type from canonical(ActivityDefinition|PlanDefinition|Questionnaire) to canonical(...) | uri. Commit 72f0fdf2f4 immediately followed by updating PlanDefinition examples from the pre-choice definition element to definitionCanonical where they referenced FHIR resources.
additional_context: The current build no longer uses the historical spreadsheet as the active source, but source/fhir.ini includes PlanDefinition as an active resource and source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml preserves PlanDefinition.action.definition[x] with both canonical and uri type choices. Later applied issue FHIR-48981 clarified the purpose of definitionUri and added matching RequestOrchestration behavior; the current PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration source contains that clarification, so it reinforces rather than reverses FHIR-18186.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active PlanDefinition StructureDefinition already allows definitionUri in addition to definitionCanonical and includes current explanatory text for the uri case.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied clarification of PlanDefinition.action.definitionUri semantics and RequestOrchestration carry-through; confirms the uri choice remains intentional.
